description: This file contains unit tests for local data store operations in an Orleans-based application, including read, write, delete, and multi-row operations, as well as utility functions and class definitions related to testing persistence mechanisms.

classes.name: ProviderType
classes.description: Enumeration of different storage provider types such as AzureTable, Memory, Mock, File, and AdoNet.

classes.name: LocalStoreTests
classes.description: Test class containing unit tests for local data store operations including read, write, delete, and multi-row operations.

methods.name: Store_Read
methods.description: Tests reading data from the local data store and verifies the retrieved data matches expected values.

methods.name: Store_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing data to the store and then reading it back to verify data integrity.

methods.name: Store_Delete
methods.description: Tests deleting a row from the store and verifies that subsequent reads reflect the deletion.

methods.name: Store_ReadMulti
methods.description: Tests reading multiple rows from the store based on a common key.

methods.name: GrainState_Store_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing and reading grain state data to/from the store.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Utility method to generate keys for a grain based on its type and ID.

methods.name: AsDictionary
methods.description: Utility method to convert an object's properties into a dictionary.
